title: ARINC 664 Part 7 (AFDX) synthetic traffic configuration
description: Structural rules for virtual links, frame fields and the redundancy premise. Cross-field rules (SkewMax <= 253 x BAG, unique VL IDs, payload fits Lmax) live in afdx_synth.validate_config because JSON Schema cannot express them. Sources are secondary (Abaco AFDX tutorial, UEI ARINC 664 manual); record this in the task docs.

redundancy.description: Receiver-side premise. Tasks MUST state the resync rule: the same frames give different accept/drop sets under the two rules (catalogue C1).

vl_id.description: 16-bit Virtual Link ID, carried in the last 2 bytes of the destination MAC. 0 is excluded here by design choice.

bag_ms.description: Bandwidth Allocation Gap in milliseconds. Permitted values are powers of two from 1 to 128.

lmax_bytes.description: Largest Ethernet frame on this VL, including the 4-byte FCS (scapy frames omit the FCS).

skew_max_ms.description: SkewMax in ms. Cross-field rule: <= 253 x bag_ms.

src_ip.description: Source IPv4 address, private class A (10.x.x.x). Destination IP is derived: 224.224.<vl_id hi>.<vl_id lo>.

src_mac_user_id.description: 16-bit user-defined field of the source MAC (02:00:00:<user id>:<interface id << 5>).

interface_id.description: 3-bit interface ID in the source MAC.

app_payload_bytes.description: Application bytes before padding and the 1-byte sequence number. Upper bound depends on lmax_bytes (cross-field rule).

networks.description: Networks the VL is transmitted on. Both A and B carry the same sequence number by design.

initial_sn.description: First sequence number sent. 1..255; 0 is reserved for reset.
